learnings.title: Shopify developer changelog feed: Global Catalog REST API stops serving traffic on November 2, 2026
learnings.claim: Shopify developer changelog feed fetched 2026-10-09 lists as newest item: "Global Catalog REST API stops serving traffic on November 2, 2026" (Fri, 09 Oct 2026 16:00:00 +0000). Not independently verified.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: The 'video_shopify' plan should audit its codebase for dependencies on the Global Catalog REST API and schedule a migration to the recommended GraphQL API prior to the November 2, 2026 deprecation date.
learnings.next_measurement: Reviewer opens the item link and confirms relevance before promotion.
